title: Welcome
subtitle: An example quest book
text:
This book shows every kind of quest Simple Books has. Each chapter is one style: a checklist, two trees, a story, chores that repeat, a supply depot, paths that split and a bounty board.
The last tab is your team. Make one there and invite friends to share progress.

steps.text: Open First Steps and tick the first box.
Quests unlock as you finish the ones they depend on. Locked quests say what they need.
Finished quests have rewards to claim. Every player claims their own.
